metadata.description: Lookback time prediction t_L(z) and cosmic age t(z) in Gyr. Computed from the background expansion H(z) via a line-of-sight integral. The module reports the present age of the universe t0 and the age at key redshifts, useful for comparing to galaxy ages and star-formation histories.
metadata.notes: Lookback time and cosmic age computed from H(z) via a line-of-sight integral.
